name: The Last Order
source:
After a brutal betrayal, Don Vito’s empire hangs by a thread. You are Michael Gambino, the family’s ultimate weapon, forced to vanish and start a new life as a “normal” college student.
Hidden in a house full of breathtaking women the seductive Monica and the irresistible Emily and Ava you must navigate a world of high-stakes tension and forbidden desires.
Will you rebuild your family’s legacy from the shadows, or will you lose yourself in the intoxicating pleasures of your new life? In this city, power is the ultimate aphrodisiac, and revenge has never looked this beautiful.
Your choices. Your empire. Your girls.
translation:
在一次残酷的背叛之后，唐·维托的帝国岌岌可危。你是迈克尔·甘比诺，家庭的终极武器，被迫消失并开始作为“正常”大学生的新生活。
隐藏在充满令人惊叹的女人的房子里，诱人的莫妮卡和不可抗拒的艾米丽和艾娃，你必须在一个充满高风险紧张和禁忌欲望的世界中航行。
你会从阴影中重建家族的遗产，还是会迷失在新生活的令人陶醉的乐趣中？在这座城市里，权力是终极春药，复仇从未如此美好。
你的选择。你的帝国。你的女孩们。
